items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original 16:9 wide Japanese junior-high textbook scene for learning the classical Chinese tale about a merchant's contradictory claims. Main central illustration: a friendly ancient Chinese market merchant proudly showing a broad wooden shield in one hand and a long simple spear in the other, with two or three attentive bystanders reacting with curious, mildly puzzled expressions. Shield and spear are clearly recognizable and separate; nobody attacks anyone. Show this historical scene in a large picture book being viewed by two modern Japanese junior-high students at the lower edge, outside the historical picture, with plain uniforms and naturally curious faces. Warm soft hand-drawn watercolor/flat texture, clear shapes, rounded expressive characters, muted green/blue/orange, simple traditional market backdrop. Original composition and characters, not copied from textbook art or modern franchises. No text, Chinese characters, calligraphy, numbers, labels, speech-balloon writing, shop-sign writing, logos or watermark. Book pages contain only the picture. No violent or frightening expression, no conclusion or answer written. Single finished illustration, no variations or grid.

items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original wide 16:9 scene for a Japanese junior-high textbook introducing the public-domain story The Spider's Thread. Main picture inside an open illustrated book: ONE delicate continuous silver spider thread descends from a bright tranquil lotus pond above into a deep shadowy blue-purple cavern below. A small generic human silhouette at the bottom looks up and reaches toward the thread, showing a possible path to hope; do NOT show the thread breaking or the story's final outcome. Clear visual contrast between the peaceful lotus pond and the dark depth. A tiny ordinary spider beside the upper end; only ONE thread. Two Japanese first-year junior-high students in plain school uniforms look thoughtfully at the book from the foreground, outside the depicted story. Gentle evocative hand-painted educational illustration, rounded shapes, uncluttered and readable, subdued blue/purple with warm soft light, no horror, gore, torture, flames or frightening faces, no depiction of punishment. No lettering, calligraphy, numerals, labels, printed lines, logos, watermarks, recognizable famous character designs or copied book artwork. Single finished image, not a grid.
